sourceParameters.scope: Jointly modelled coeval components using separate absolute V and dynamical masses

nuoct-2025.query: select hostname,st_refname,st_mass,st_rad,st_lum,st_teff,st_met,st_age and their errors from ps where hostname like 'nu Oct%'

radius_solar.section: Derived volume-equivalent radius from Table 3 Aa pole/equator
radius_solar.method: Volume-equivalent oblate spheroid radius (R_equator^2 R_pole)^(1/3); approximate covariance-free error

temperature_k.caveat: Mira variable, observed phase 0.13; radius and temperature vary over the cycle. Not a mean photosphere or a prediction for the current phase. The far-fainter companion is not the observed M-giant.

radius_solar.caveat: Mira variable, observed phase 0.13; radius and temperature vary over the cycle. Not a mean photosphere or a prediction for the current phase. The far-fainter companion is not the observed M-giant.

luminosity_solar.section: Derived from the same phase 0.13 Rosseland radius/temperature
luminosity_solar.method: Stefan-Boltzmann at the same observed phase; approximate covariance-free uncertainty
luminosity_solar.caveat: Phase 0.13 photospheric estimate, not cycle-averaged luminosity; no mixed-phase or current-phase prediction.
